datasets.name: latest_prices
queryLines:
SELECT
  symbol,
  ROUND(latest_live_price, 2) AS latest_live_price,
  latest_live_event_time,
  latest_historical_date,
  ROUND(latest_historical_close, 2) AS latest_historical_close,
  ROUND(latest_historical_change_pct, 2) AS latest_historical_change_pct,
  ROUND(price_difference, 2) AS price_difference,
  ROUND(price_difference_pct, 2) AS price_difference_pct,
  ROUND(change_pct_24h, 2) AS change_pct_24h,
  ROUND(high_price_24h, 2) AS high_price_24h,
  ROUND(low_price_24h, 2) AS low_price_24h,
  ROUND(volume_24h, 2) AS volume_24h,
  gold_updated_at
FROM
  dbr_dev.parvinbadalov.demo1_crypto_latest_prices_gold
ORDER BY
  symbol

datasets.name: live_vs_historical
queryLines:
SELECT
  symbol,
  ROUND(latest_live_price, 2) AS latest_live_price,
  ROUND(latest_historical_close, 2) AS latest_historical_close,
  ROUND(price_difference, 2) AS price_difference,
  ROUND(price_difference_pct, 2) AS price_difference_pct
FROM dbr_dev.parvinbadalov.demo1_crypto_latest_prices_gold
ORDER BY symbol

datasets.name: historical_daily_close
queryLines:
SELECT
  trade_date,
  symbol,
  close,
  volume,
  price_change_pct,
  candle_direction
FROM dbr_dev.parvinbadalov.demo1_crypto_ohlcv_silver
ORDER BY trade_date, symbol

datasets.name: historical_return
queryLines:
SELECT
  symbol,
  ROUND(historical_return_pct, 2) AS historical_return_pct,
  ROUND(first_open_price, 2) AS first_open_price,
  ROUND(last_close_price, 2) AS last_close_price,
  historical_start_date,
  historical_end_date
FROM dbr_dev.parvinbadalov.demo1_crypto_market_summary_gold
ORDER BY historical_return_pct DESC

datasets.name: historical_price_range
queryLines:
SELECT
  symbol,
  ROUND(period_minimum_low, 2) AS period_minimum_low,
  ROUND(period_maximum_high, 2) AS period_maximum_high,
  ROUND(historical_price_range, 2) AS historical_price_range,
  ROUND(latest_live_price, 2) AS latest_live_price
FROM dbr_dev.parvinbadalov.demo1_crypto_market_summary_gold
ORDER BY symbol

datasets.name: candle_direction
queryLines:
SELECT
  symbol,
  bullish_days,
  bearish_days,
  neutral_days
FROM dbr_dev.parvinbadalov.demo1_crypto_market_summary_gold
ORDER BY symbol

datasets.name: streaming_price_trend
queryLines:
SELECT
  event_time,
  symbol,
  price_usd,
  change_pct_24h,
  producer_id
FROM dbr_dev.parvinbadalov.demo1_crypto_ticks_silver
ORDER BY event_time, symbol

datasets.name: streaming_metrics
queryLines:
SELECT
  symbol,
  streaming_event_count,
  evolved_event_count,
  ROUND(streaming_minimum_price, 2) AS streaming_minimum_price,
  ROUND(streaming_maximum_price, 2) AS streaming_maximum_price,
  ROUND(streaming_average_price, 2) AS streaming_average_price,
  ROUND(average_ingestion_delay_seconds, 2) AS average_ingestion_delay_seconds
FROM dbr_dev.parvinbadalov.demo1_crypto_market_summary_gold
ORDER BY symbol

datasets.name: market_24h
queryLines:
SELECT
  symbol,
  ROUND(latest_live_price, 2) AS latest_live_price,
  ROUND(change_pct_24h, 2) AS change_pct_24h,
  ROUND(high_price_24h, 2) AS high_price_24h,
  ROUND(low_price_24h, 2) AS low_price_24h,
  ROUND(volume_24h, 2) AS volume_24h,
  latest_live_event_time
FROM dbr_dev.parvinbadalov.demo1_crypto_latest_prices_gold
ORDER BY symbol

datasets.name: kpi_summary
queryLines:
SELECT
  MAX(gold_updated_at) AS as_of,
  COUNT(DISTINCT symbol) AS total_symbols,
  ROUND(AVG(latest_live_price), 2) AS avg_live_price,
  ROUND(MAX(change_pct_24h), 2) AS max_gain_pct_24h,
  ROUND(SUM(volume_24h), 0) AS total_volume_24h
FROM
  dbr_dev.parvinbadalov.demo1_crypto_latest_prices_gold

lines: Real-time and historical performance across tracked cryptocurrency pairs — filter by symbol, date range, or candle direction.
Live tick data, streaming metrics, price ranges, and dashboard freshness.
Top-line aggregated metrics across all tracked crypto symbols, sourced from the gold-layer prices table.

## How to Read This Dashboard

---

#### 🎛️ Filters
**Symbol** — pick one or more crypto pairs to isolate their data across every chart on the page.
**Date Range** — narrow historical charts to a specific time window.
**Candle Direction** — show only Bullish, Bearish, or Neutral trading days.

---

#### 📈 Historical Analysis
* **Close Price Over Time** — daily closing price trend per symbol
* **Historical Return %** — total percentage gain/loss from first open to last close
* **Trading Volume Over Time** — cumulative daily traded volume colored by symbol
* **Bullish / Bearish / Neutral Days** — breakdown of candle direction counts per symbol

---

#### ⚡ Live & Streaming
* **Live Streaming Price Trend** — real-time tick prices from the streaming feed
* **24h Change % by Symbol** — today's percentage move vs the prior close
* **Streaming Event Metrics** — event counts, ingestion latency, and min/max/avg prices

---

#### 🏦 Market Snapshot
* **24-Hour Market Snapshot** — live price alongside 24 h high, low, and volume per symbol
* **Live vs Historical** — compares the latest tick price against the last recorded historical close
* **Historical Price Range** — full-period high–low spread per symbol

---

#### 💡 Tips
* Counters at the top of the KPI section always reflect **all symbols** — they are not affected by the Symbol filter.
* The **Dashboard Last Refreshed** widget shows when the gold-layer table was last written by the upstream pipeline.
